description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'RootSupervisorStrategyFactory' that creates and provides a supervisor strategy for Akka actors. It specifically creates a OneForOneStrategy with custom handling for various exception types to determine whether to restart, resume, escalate, or ignore failures in child actors.

classes.name: RootSupervisorStrategyFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static method to create a supervised actor strategy with custom exception handling logic.

methods.name: createStrategy
methods.description: Creates a 'OneForOneStrategy' with exception handling logic to decide whether to restart, resume, escalate, or ignore failures in child actors, based on exception types.
